flags: WATERFRONT (stored riverfront, signed --Claude evidence, not --AWH) - DOWNGRADE CANDIDATE to riverview. The stored evidence rests on the park's per-site map (marked 'Map not to scale'), which draws the west rows 15-22 and 51-60 along River Beach Trail on the Smith River side. On imagery the loops are hidden under unbroken redwood canopy, so no pad can be measured. West of the forest edge an open cobble bar ~45-70 m wide runs to a wetted channel ~80 m wide (a river by width). The summer water is therefore ~55-100 m from the forest edge plus however far the pads sit inside the trees. The case for keeping it: the bar is the river's own high-water bed, so measured to the high-water edge the water reaches the treeline. Satellite can only veto under canopy, and nothing site-level confirms a pad within ~50 m over open ground. Read: riverview at best on the default-down rule, unless site photos of 15-22 / 51-60 show open ground to the bar.
